**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve lookup of pre-upgrade package directories**

For packages installed before this commit whose valid manifest ID requires encoding (for example, `field imagery`), the previous installer stored the directory using the raw ID, but rehydration now probes only `encodeURIComponent(manifest.id)`. Because the manifest schema still permits arbitrary nonempty IDs and there is no legacy fallback or migration, these persisted packages silently disappear from the runtime after upgrading until the user reimports them; probe and safely migrate the legacy raw-ID directory before relying exclusively on the encoded name.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Recover package swaps interrupted after the backup rename**

If the process or device terminates after the active directory is moved to `backup` but before `pending` is promoted, the catch block cannot restore it. On the next launch, rehydration checks only the active package directory and never reconciles `.previous-*` or `.pending-*`, so an otherwise complete installed package remains unavailable despite its intact backup; add startup reconciliation or use a replacement scheme that always leaves a discoverable active edition.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

discovery.confirmedBy: coordinator and package recovery implementer, source inspection; regression proof pending
discovery.boundary: Prior executed source/browser results remain actual at their dated edition. Newly confirmed native installer compatibility/crash-recovery findings require fresh source qualification before merge. No installed-device execution inferred.

regressionEvidence.claimClass: source/unit-contract with actual native module and simulated Expo filesystem; not device, power-loss durability, multiprocess locking or render readiness

apiVerification.observation: Directory.move returns Promise<void> and native AsyncFunction; Directory.moveSync returns void and native Function on Android/iOS 57.0.7. Adapter now calls moveSync.

failingBefore.method: Same final 45-case harness loads preserved original 62462a1 native/core files through constrained Expo memory bridge. Failures are observable assertions, not absent-new-export errors.

passingAfter.existingArchiveAssertions: passed (suite emits no numeric assertion count)

selectedBehavior: Safe raw legacy IDs remain in place and use ephemeral runtime URLs; no migration or synthesized manifest is written. Existing originals retained; only derived runtime TileJSON sidecar may be written after full admission.
Current/backup editions with recorded manifests must match normalized requested metadata, including identity/provenance/policy. Encoded-only unrecorded ambiguous locations refuse.

Absent active directory restores fully admitted unique paired prior transaction (historical backups retained), or sole prior when no pending exists. Pending is never activated. Multiple/unpaired/unsafe/invalid entries refuse without mutation.
Valid active edition remains authoritative; invalid active cannot silently select a prior edition. Failed restore and derived-sidecar writes preserve originals and permit retry.
Installation refuses reserved internal transaction identities, same-path different recorded identity/unrecorded encoded collisions, and later encoded-ID replacement while safe raw legacy exists.

Any existing active destination without a recorded manifest refuses replacement before writes, including safe plain-ID legacy editions, because an unrecorded prior edition cannot later qualify as a transaction backup. Legacy rehydration remains supported in place.

A recorded same-ID edition may be replaced with a newly admitted source edition, retaining exact old manifest/resource bytes in its prior transaction directory; the new source rehydrates against its own recorded metadata.
limits: No device/emulator filesystem or native map rendering exercised.
JS-turn serialization is not multiprocess locking or a power-loss/atomic-filesystem guarantee.
Legacy encoded-ID migration is deferred; explicit later encoded installation refuses until the raw legacy edition is inspected/reconciled through a separately qualified protocol.
Current authenticated App package resolver/native renderer integration remains outside this scope.
Root owns aggregate checks, source freeze, independent integration acceptance and Git/CI publication.
Every unrecorded legacy edition requires separate migration/reconciliation before replacement, including IDs whose encoded and raw directory names are equal.

additionalFailingBeforeInitialRecovery.failingCase: plain-ID legacy replacement refuses before moving an unrecorded active edition
additionalFailingBeforeInitialRecovery.scope: Initial recovery edition accepted unrecorded same-path plain-ID legacy replacement; final fixture demonstrates missing expected rejection.

localChecks.boundary: Actual bounded affected-source checks on the frozen native mirror. No whole validate, browser or device run inferred from these commands. Fresh exact-head protected complete source/browser qualification remains separate.

boundary: Behavioral native installer/recovery repair, not formatting equivalence. Earlier complete source/browser/Edge receipts remain actual at their original edition. Fresh exact-head complete source/browser qualification and final independent reviews are pending at this packet cutoff.
